title: {key:x} goes to {key:"}{key:-}
summary: Charwise tiny deletes leave the numbered registers alone.

frames.caption: Line yanked — it sits in {key:"}{key:1}.
frames.narration: A full-line yank fills the numbered register. Next we'll make a *small* delete.

frames.caption: {key:x} deletes one character into {key:"}{key:-}.
frames.narration: Small charwise deletes go to the small-delete register, so {key:"}{key:1} still holds the yanked line.

frames.caption: {key:"}{key:1}{key:p} still pastes the line.
frames.narration: That's the point of {key:"}{key:-}: typos don't clobber the delete you meant to keep.
